correctness.rationale: For one fixed complete rank-one product resolution, commuting with every projector is equivalent to being diagonal in that product basis. Classical-classical diagonalization automatically refines the marginal spectral projectors. Requiring commutation for all refinements forces each distinct marginal product block to commute with the full matrix algebra generated by product rank-one projectors, hence to be scalar. Positivity, normalization, and the marginal trace constraints complete the characterization. The two-qubit witness is verified entrywise.

value.rationale: The theorem gives the exact degeneracy boundary for a widely used spectral-measurement shortcut. It distinguishes existence of a compatible eigenbasis from invariance under arbitrary eigenbases and identifies precisely when the shortcut is basis-safe. This is a structural correction rather than a parameter substitution or recomputation.
